title: Monitoring and evaluation.
bodyText: Every grant shall be monitored by the expending agency to ensure compliance with this chapter and the public purpose and legislative intent of the grant.
bodyHtml: §42F-106  Monitoring and evaluation.  Every grant shall be monitored by the expending agency to ensure compliance with this chapter and the public purpose and legislative intent of the grant. [L 1997, c 190, pt of §3; am L 2014, c 96, §10]
